articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process video streams, audio, and code repositories in a single context window exceeding 1 million tokens. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on ARC-AGI-2 over the previous generation, with significantly reduced hallucination rates. The model is available via API with new structured-output guarantees that make agentic tool-use pipelines substantially more reliable.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored a verified 92% on a curated set of International Mathematical Olympiad problems, surpassing all prior AI systems. The model uses a novel chain-of-verification architecture that cross-checks intermediate proof steps against a formal theorem prover. Researchers say the approach could accelerate automated theorem proving and scientific discovery workflows.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Deploys 500 Humanoid Workers Across BMW Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Figure announced that its Figure 03 humanoid robots have reached a deployment milestone of 500 units actively working across three BMW assembly plants in the US and Germany. The robots handle complex multi-step tasks including wire harness routing and quality inspection using on-board vision-language models. BMW reports a 22% throughput increase in deployed sections with a significant reduction in repetitive-strain injuries among human workers.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Disaster Search-and-Rescue Missions
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated its electric Atlas humanoid robot completing a fully autonomous search-and-rescue scenario in a collapsed building environment, navigating rubble, opening doors, and identifying simulated victims. The system combines LiDAR-based SLAM with a fine-tuned vision-language model for semantic scene understanding and real-time path replanning. FEMA has begun a pilot evaluation program for potential deployment alongside human first responders.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Monitoring Framework as Open-Source Safety Standard
articles.summary: Anthropic open-sourced its internal Constitutional AI monitoring framework, providing real-time interpretability dashboards and automated red-teaming pipelines that other labs and enterprises can integrate into their own model deployments. The toolkit includes mechanistic interpretability probes that can surface deceptive reasoning patterns in chain-of-thought outputs. Several major AI labs and the EU AI Office have signaled interest in adopting it as a baseline compliance tool under the EU AI Act.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node, Powering Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node has entered high-volume manufacturing at its Arizona Fab 2 facility, marking the first sub-2nm volume production on US soil. The node delivers a 30% power efficiency gain over N2, which is critical for next-generation AI training and inference chips. Apple, Nvidia, and AMD are reported to be among the first customers with tape-outs expected to reach products by early 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: Neuralink announced FDA clearance for its N2 implant, a second-generation BCI device with 4,096 electrodes — quadruple the channel count of its first-generation chip — and fully wireless high-bandwidth data streaming. Early clinical trial participants with spinal cord injuries demonstrated cursor control speeds approaching able-bodied typing rates. The clearance covers a pivotal trial expansion to 50 patients across multiple US medical centers.

articles.title: Toyota Research Institute Unveils Dexterous Bi-Manual Robot That Learns Household Tasks from 10-Minute Demonstrations
articles.summary: TRI presented a new diffusion-policy-based learning system that enables a bi-manual mobile manipulator to acquire complex household skills — such as folding laundry, loading dishwashers, and organizing shelves — from just a few minutes of human teleoperation data. The system generalizes across object shapes and cluttered environments without task-specific engineering. TRI plans to integrate the platform into a consumer home-assistant prototype slated for limited beta testing in 2027.
